summary.name: Adala
summary.one_liner: Adala is an autonomous data labeling agent framework for Python that learns skills from a ground truth dataset to label data.
use_cases: automatically label text data with an LLM
bootstrapping labels from a small ground truth dataset
running labeling agents inside a Python notebook
summary.what_it_does:
Adala is a Python framework for building agents that perform data processing, focused on data labeling. Agents are defined with an environment (a ground truth dataset via StaticEnvironment), one or more skills (such as ClassificationSkill with labels, instructions and input/output templates), and runtimes that connect to LLM providers. The agent learns its skills iteratively via agent.learn(...) with a learning iteration count and accuracy threshold, then applies them to new data via agent.run(...). The page's quickstart shows usage as a standalone library in a Python notebook with pandas DataFrames and OpenAI's gpt-3.5-turbo. The reference sections list agents, datasets, environments, memories, runtimes and skills.</what_it_does>
